steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap warm crimson onto canvas
steps.rule: winter scenes need some warmth so they do not feel cold

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay warm color low on canvas
steps.rule: warm color reflects into the snow

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: crisscross prussian blue into the warm color
steps.rule: strong blue overpowers the warm color quickly
steps.new: leave small openings for later clouds

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: wash brush then blend sky with clean dry brush
steps.load: wash in thinner, shake off, dry

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: add small cloud indications in white

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend and fluff sky very lightly
steps.rule: too much blending makes the clouds disappear

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: mix dark color for evergreens
steps.rule: the strong blue keeps the mix mostly blue

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap dark mix onto canvas, leaving some pink
steps.rule: keep enough warm color so the canvas stays warm

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: pick out individual trees with fan brush corner
steps.rule: saves time compared to painting each tree separately
steps.new: knife, 1in or 2in brush can also make trees

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: lift a clean brush upward to make mist at the base
steps.rule: creates the illusion of mist down low

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: load dark base color for closer trees
steps.load: loaded with base mix, light color wiped off first
steps.rule: a base color saves a lot of time on layered trees
steps.new: keep the mist from being covered

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: paint darker closer trees with dark mix
steps.load: wiped off light color, loaded full of dark mix
steps.rule: darker trees look closer and push lighter ones back

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: add tree tops and little arms

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape thin trunk marks
steps.rule: suggest trunks without much detail

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: load brush with plenty of white

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: pull white up through tree bottoms
steps.rule: the pulled color becomes the shadows under the trees

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: pull tree bottoms hard and lift upward for grass
steps.rule: pulling cleans up the edges of the tree shapes

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add white over the canvas, keeping pinks and blues showing
steps.motion: tapping and letting color show through
steps.rule: thick paint lets thinner layers sit on top without mud

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out an initial cabin shape with the knife
steps.rule: scraping removes excess paint so the next layer sticks
steps.new: lay out the cabin without committing to it

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a chimney shape
steps.rule: a scraped outline helps you remember where it sits
steps.new: chimney will sit up and over the roof

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay snow along the roof edge
steps.load: white pulled flat and cut across for a roll
steps.rule: roof angles matter a lot
steps.new: sharpen the edge then smooth it out

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: lay brown along the back eave
steps.load: roll of brown cut off the knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: mix dark sienna and van dyke brown and pull down the wall
steps.load: lightly mixed, roll cut off the knife
steps.rule: leave a spot for the chimney

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: mix a light wall color and pull down
steps.rule: holes left in the paint suggest age

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: darken the far side of the cabin with added brown
steps.load: added brown to the same color
steps.rule: a darker side makes a clear difference

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: place the chimney top with brown
steps.new: chimney top sits at a slight angle

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: mix bright red and van dyke brown and bounce the knife for bricks
steps.rule: bouncing the knife makes a brick texture

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: touch snow on the top of the roof and the other roof side
steps.where: roof top and other roof side

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: bring out a porch roof with brown
steps.load: a little brown on the knife
steps.rule: a little brown lets brown show through the white

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: pull out the porch floor underneath
steps.rule: keep the highlight small because the area underneath is dark

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add railing, light edges, board lines and a window
steps.new: scraping in a window is easy

steps.subject: other: small details
steps.action: thin white with liquid clear and add little details
steps.load: thinned with a touch of liquid clear
steps.rule: clear makes the paint flow and dry with a shine

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: wiggle white and brown on the knife to make a snow fence with wires
steps.load: brown and white on the knife

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push upward with fan brush to form a bush
steps.rule: letting the dark color mix into the shadows is desirable

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a tree trunk with fan brush
steps.load: loaded brown on the fan brush
steps.new: adds a second tree beside it

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add a few small limbs with liner brush

steps.subject: other: birch trees
steps.action: pull white in z shapes for birch trees
